purpose: Verify primary university sources and provenance of supporting faculty-maintained materials.

statusDefinitions.official-institutional: Institution-hosted course/program/catalog/schedule or institution-authorized syllabus provider.
statusDefinitions.faculty-maintained-verified: Faculty-maintained course materials corroborated through institutional faculty/course/laboratory records.
statusDefinitions.unverified: This audit did not establish independent institutional sponsorship of the exact offering.

records.title: PPDE 642: Advanced Urban Analytics
records.recommendedAction: Use official USC Price electives page as the card landing source; retain instructor repository in supporting sources/materials.
records.evidenceSummary: Official USC Price curriculum lists PPDE642 AdvancedUrbanAnalytics. USC faculty profile establishes GeoffBoeing’s appointment; official USC Today profile links his personal geoffboeing.com website. His lab page names this course and the GitHub repository identifies his USC course and appliedML contents. The external repository is faculty-maintained material for a university-verified course, rather than an uncorroborated course claim.
records.limits: No direct USC.edu link to the exact PPDE642 GitHub repository was found during this audit. Course existence/code and instructor affiliation are independently corroborated. The proposed university landing page confirms course code/title but is not itself the detailed syllabus.
records.secondaryMaterialsProvenance: Faculty-maintained materials corroborated through university sources; use the institutional landing page as the primary link.

records.title: Urban AI: AI-Driven Decision Support for Real-World Urban Challenges

records.title: GEOG 495/428: Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
records.recommendedAction: Use official UW Summer2025 course page as the card landing source; retain its explicitly linked GitHub syllabus as supporting materials.
records.evidenceSummary: The official UW Geography Summer2025 course page identifies BoZhao, labels GeospatialArtificialIntelligence, and explicitly links the exact https://github.com/jakobzhao/geog428 syllabus. The university-hosted HGISLab teaching page also links that repository. This establishes institutional endorsement of the externally hosted materials.
records.limits: The Summer2026 section is withdrawn. Current dataset already distinguishes the documented Summer2025 offering and does not claim the2026 section ran.
records.secondaryMaterialsProvenance: Faculty-maintained materials corroborated through university sources; use the institutional landing page as the primary link.

records.institution: The University of Texas at Austin
records.title: CRP 386: AI in Planning
records.evidenceSummary: UT Austin Provost’s official page explicitly links utexas.simplesyllabus.com as the UT Austin SimpleSyllabus Library, explains Canvas integration and faculty publishing, and identifies it as an official syllabus service. The exact CRP386 Spring2025 PDF is indexed on this university-specific provider tenant.
records.limits: The PDF timed out during this provenance pass; the official provider relationship is independently established. Earlier content verification inspected the syllabus. Do not classify it unofficial merely because its authorized provider uses a .com domain.
